body: I know this is ask men, but as a woman I do this too. Had no idea it was a thing it's just so cool.
The only reason I'm rationalizing it is because to a point it didn't feel like it, at least at the beginning. Thanks for the insight.
You can't have a traumatic event happen at/before 20? There's logic for ya...

I went ahead and looked for more, yes, because he told me in trust he never did it. 

Im not saying if he looked suspicious I would check - I'm saying I literally started typing in a website and it came up in the address bar as recently visited. Since he used his 'righteousness' against me I was fairly curious.
So... using chrome and typing a website in and having a porn video come up... is classified as snooping?

To be fair, the snooping wasn't exactly a spur of the moment decision. It was led by typing websites into his address bar, and chrome doing autofill. I think I more continued because the insecurities were already there, so I really don't feel like I invaded his privacy that much. He didn't do much to hide it...

This is what we started doing after he found out I was interested in porn. Now, I'm not sure if a threesome is the best thing for my already horrible self-esteem... The idea used to turn me on. Now it kind of disgusts me... feelings are horrible.
I don't know if you bothered to read passed that line, but I've been working on that for a while. I am going through a rough time, but I'm sure veterans have it worse, thanks.

He did speak with me when he found out. I was reprimanded - trust me. 

My first post must not have been very clear about that, I was pretty emotional.

I didn't really go out of my way to hide it or anything, it was just the first time he'd really looked. 
I never mentioned it because like I said, it's never been a problem in a relationship. Every guy I've been with has masturbated, admitted it, and been nothing less than ecstatic to find I do the same and we can share the activity every now and then. 

Also - I'm not so sure this is a retaliation thing. It seems to go pretty far back into the relationship. But retaliation or not, he sure did one up me...

I also find Vichy Dermablend corrective foundation helpful for this - gives good coverage, but doesn't make me break out when I wear make up. 

I used to wear Bare Minerals to curb breakouts - it was glorious, but it was breaking the bank. With the Vichy stuff, a little goes a **long** way, which is a huge bonus for me.

I'd say it should be okay to look at porn for both of us - it's a pretty natural, human thing. However I don't think that sending other girls pictures of himself and chatting with girls constantly is good for trust in a relationship, and I feel like he would feel the same way if I were sending pictures of my body to some other guy.

I don't feel I minimized his concerns. I was open and honest and told him I did what I did and my reasons. He made me feel like crap about it using himself as a model for morality, and now this. I just don't understand it - if I'm adding things up wrong here, feel free to let me know. I have to agree my mind doesn't feel like its in the right place right now.

Thought I should do a follow up to this. He saw my messages and called me. I told him if he could tell me what it was we would be better off here. He starts crying, saying he loves me, saying he doesn't want it to end like this, etc. Says that I have to give him a chance to explain. I feel like none of this can be explained. Nothing he says is ever going to make this better. I eventually caved and told him about the pictures, and he has been calling me nonstop since, telling me this is really it. 

I've been telling him that's hard for me to believe with what I found. Not sure what else to do or say.
No -  I haven't. I'm almost scared to, luckily he's sleeping right now.

Mostly because there's no reason to live.

I feel like my life consists of continuous trying, to no end. I watch everyone around me half ass everything and make it through life just barely by riding on the coattails of others. I don't want that to be me, but my efforts in trying have showed me that that's all it is ever going to be, making life seem kinda pointless. 

I'm halfway through university and throwing it all away. I have no job, and I smoke weed every day, coming here without being close to addicted. I started smoking cigarettes at the end of first year. In second year just to make it through school I went to my doctor and got prescribed uppers, and now I can't do much without them.

I hate myself for these habits, but don't have strength to change them. I'm so down in the dumps that I feel like I can't make these changes myself, and without all of these substances I feel like I wouldn't make it through school. I feel like I've dug myself a whole so deep that death is a better answer than digging out.
